messages:
Leah Morgan: Following up on the routing-loop postmortem 1: I'm collecting owners for the remediation actions so we can track in the remediation board. Please claim items and paste Jira links. Aim: owners + tickets by EOD Wed.

Leah Morgan: Actions: 1) Add route-mismatch detector and auto-label incidents. 2) Harden router config validation in CI. 3) Add a rollback-safe deploy step to the release checklist. 4) Backfill incidents for the last 12 months and surface recurrence. 5) Draft handoff playbook + RACI for routing incidents.

Arjun Patel: I6ll take #2 (CI config validation). Will add a lint job and a gating test for config diffs. ETA: 1 week.

Arjun Patel: Jira: INFRA-9001 "router-config-lint + gating-test". Link in ticket includes test spec.

Samira Khan: I can own #1 (detector + auto-label). Prototype will be a percentile-based rule then tune. Need TOOLS help to add label.

Samira Khan: Ticket created: TOOLS-4772 "route-mismatch-detector + auto-label". Assigning to Samira for prototype.

Leah Morgan: For #3 (rollback-safe deploy) I can add the checklist item. Suggest gating on a canary validation that checks route stability for 5m. Any objections?

Arjun Patel: +1. Also add a step to validate config hash across control plane nodes.

ToolingBot: Reminder set: owners check-in in 24 hours (2612349378). Auto-export scheduled: incident events (12 months) -> analytics-bucket (job 2612351000).

Samira Khan: For #4 backfill, I'll run initial queries once export completes. Will post a recurrence heatmap in TOOLS-4772.

Leah Morgan: For #5 RACI draft: Responsible = oncall owner, Accountable = routing lead, Consulted = infra, Informed = product. I'll draft the playbook and ping oncall for review.

Arjun Patel: I'll add the gating test to INFRA-9001 and link the rollback checklist.

Samira Khan: Small note: add an incident label "route-loop" when detector fires so we can track regressions easily. Will add as a subtask in TOOLS-4772.

Leah Morgan: Summary: owners assigned (INFRA-9001 Arjun, TOOLS-4772 Samira), export scheduled, RACI agreed. I'll move these into the remediation tracker after tickets have due dates. Please ACK here.

Arjun Patel: ACK.

Samira Khan: ACK.

Leah Morgan: Thanks everyone. Ping this thread if blockers show up.
